name: read -u sees current bytes from an independent open without sharing its cursor
command:
exec 3<> sample.bin
open3_rc=$?
printf 'open3_rc=%s\n' "$open3_rc"
if test "$open3_rc" -ne 0; then exit "$open3_rc"; fi
exec 4<> sample.bin
open4_rc=$?
printf 'open4_rc=%s\n' "$open4_rc"
if test "$open4_rc" -ne 0; then exit "$open4_rc"; fi
printf X >&3
write_x_rc=$?
printf 'write_x_rc=%s\n' "$write_x_rc"
if test "$write_x_rc" -ne 0; then exit "$write_x_rc"; fi
IFS= read -r -u4 value
read_rc=$?
printf 'read_rc=%s\nvalue=%s\n' "$read_rc" "$value"
if test "$read_rc" -ne 0; then exit "$read_rc"; fi
printf Y >&3
write_y_rc=$?
printf 'write_y_rc=%s\n' "$write_y_rc"
if test "$write_y_rc" -ne 0; then exit "$write_y_rc"; fi
printf Z >&4
write_z_rc=$?
printf 'write_z_rc=%s\n' "$write_z_rc"
if test "$write_z_rc" -ne 0; then exit "$write_z_rc"; fi
test "$value" = XBCD
value_equal_rc=$?
printf 'value_equal_rc=%s\n' "$value_equal_rc"
report_rc=$?
if test "$value_equal_rc" -ne 0; then exit "$value_equal_rc"; fi
exit "$report_rc"
stdout:
open3_rc=0
open4_rc=0
write_x_rc=0
read_rc=0
value=XBCD
write_y_rc=0
write_z_rc=0
value_equal_rc=0

name: read -u dup retains shared byte progress across multibyte text and a noninitial BOM
command:
exec 3<> sample.bin
open3_rc=$?
printf 'open3_rc=%s\n' "$open3_rc"
if test "$open3_rc" -ne 0; then exit 1; fi
exec 4<&3
dup_rc=$?
printf 'dup_rc=%s\n' "$dup_rc"
if test "$dup_rc" -ne 0; then exit 1; fi
read -r -u3 first
read_first_rc=$?
printf 'read_first_rc=%s\n' "$read_first_rc"
printf 'first=%s\n' "$first"
if test "$read_first_rc" -ne 0; then exit 1; fi
test "$first" = 'A中'
first_equal_rc=$?
printf 'first_equal_rc=%s\n' "$first_equal_rc"
if test "$first_equal_rc" -ne 0; then exit 1; fi
read -r -u4 second
read_second_rc=$?
printf 'read_second_rc=%s\n' "$read_second_rc"
printf 'second=%s\n' "$second"
if test "$read_second_rc" -ne 0; then exit 1; fi
test "$second" = '﻿文'
second_equal_rc=$?
printf 'second_equal_rc=%s\n' "$second_equal_rc"
if test "$second_equal_rc" -ne 0; then exit 1; fi
printf Z >&3
write_z_rc=$?
printf 'write_z_rc=%s\n' "$write_z_rc"
if test "$write_z_rc" -ne 0; then exit 1; fi
exit 0
stdout:
open3_rc=0
dup_rc=0
read_first_rc=0
first=A中
first_equal_rc=0
read_second_rc=0
second=﻿文
second_equal_rc=0
write_z_rc=0

name: read -u EOF after shortening preserves the byte cursor beyond the new length
command:
exec 3<> sample.bin
open3_rc=$?
printf 'open3_rc=%s\n' "$open3_rc"
if test "$open3_rc" -ne 0; then exit 1; fi
read -r -n4 -u3 prefix
read_prefix_rc=$?
printf 'read_prefix_rc=%s\n' "$read_prefix_rc"
printf 'prefix=%s\n' "$prefix"
if test "$read_prefix_rc" -ne 0; then exit 1; fi
test "$prefix" = ABCD
prefix_equal_rc=$?
printf 'prefix_equal_rc=%s\n' "$prefix_equal_rc"
if test "$prefix_equal_rc" -ne 0; then exit 1; fi
printf Q > sample.bin
truncate_rc=$?
printf 'truncate_rc=%s\n' "$truncate_rc"
if test "$truncate_rc" -ne 0; then exit 1; fi
read -r -u3 tail
eof_rc=$?
printf 'eof_rc=%s\n' "$eof_rc"
printf 'tail=%s\n' "$tail"
if test "$eof_rc" -ne 1; then exit 1; fi
test -z "$tail"
tail_empty_rc=$?
printf 'tail_empty_rc=%s\n' "$tail_empty_rc"
if test "$tail_empty_rc" -ne 0; then exit 1; fi
printf Z >&3
write_z_rc=$?
printf 'write_z_rc=%s\n' "$write_z_rc"
if test "$write_z_rc" -ne 0; then exit 1; fi
exit 0
stdout:
open3_rc=0
read_prefix_rc=0
prefix=ABCD
prefix_equal_rc=0
truncate_rc=0
eof_rc=1
tail=
tail_empty_rc=0
write_z_rc=0
